annotations.title: Look up an MCP server on this register

description: Look up what this register already holds about an MCP endpoint: whether it is watched, how often it is re-measured, how many measurements exist, when the first and latest were taken, and the latest verdict with the record_sha256 you can recompute yourself. Reads stored measurements only. It contacts nothing and measures nothing, so use check_conformance for a fresh reading. An endpoint that is absent is reported as absent and that is NOT a negative verdict: it means nobody has measured it here, not that it failed.

endpoint.description: https URL of the MCP endpoint to look up, exactly as it appears on the register

name: lookup_server

on_register.description: true = this endpoint is on the register. false = the register was READ and this endpoint is not on it. If the register could not be read at all, this field is not returned: the call comes back as a tool error (isError), because absence and not-knowing are different answers.
